product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic Farmhouse Stoneware Jug Home Decor Vase - 14 x 6.5 x 7.5 Inches, Antique Finish
product.description: Complete your rustic-style home with this beautiful stoneware vase. As either a container for flowers or a home accent by itself, this piece offers both functionality and stylishness. Its unique modern-vintage look blends well with a variety of home-décor styles. 13.78"H x 6.57"W x 7.48"L; Opening: 2.75" Diameter Stoneware with an antique finish This stoneware vase is designed both for display and to hold flowers or greenery.
